'''Karl Schultz Jabba s Palace Manipulator''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Karl Schultz]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-3015">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/3015 Jabba s Palace Manipulator], DeckTech (Karl "Faust" Schultz, 6 February 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/3015/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/3015/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018205125/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/3015/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Karl Schultz]]
* '''Published:''' 6 February 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Jabba s Palace Manipulator''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Jabba's Palace|JP-D-tatooinejabbaspalace.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Twi'lek Advisor|JP-D-twilekadvisor.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Expand The Empire|Premiere-D-expandtheempire.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor TatJP Schultz DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This deck is base on not letting your opponent get characters out.

'''Jabba s Palace Manipulator'''
* '''Author:''' Karl "Faust" Schultz

* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This deck is base on not letting your opponent get characters out.

=== Strategy ===

This deck was a mess-up.  Please, no one review it.  Thank you.  To see the correct version of the deck, look at "Manipulator, v.3.0"
